scientific_integrity: All claims are supported by an all-parameter constructive proof and two stand-alone finite corroboration programs. Numerical tests are not represented as proofs beyond their finite domains.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem for synchronous loopless complete graphs only, with fixed integer q>=3 and threshold theta>=1; no extension to arbitrary graphs or asynchronous updates. Asymptotic holds for fixed q and theta as n tends to infinity. The cited 1990 classical article could not be retrieved in full; independent historical priority and external mathematical validation remain open.
title: Exact run-erosion clocks for thresholded cyclic dynamics on complete graphs
